extras: Requires manual installation as an unpacked plugin; tested on macOS 26 and iOS 26.
motivation: The author built it to address the issue where copying from Google Docs loses formatting when pasted into Obsidian.
problem: Standard pasting from Google Docs loses specific formatting, often resulting in text being incorrectly bolded or losing semantic structure.
summary: Preserves formatting (bold, headings, lists, tables, images) when pasting content copied from Google Docs into Obsidian.
